nodes.label: MC-Shapley Sentence Importance Analysis
nodes.rationale: Monte-Carlo Shapley-value sentence attribution chosen to give interpretable, per-sentence importance scores for which retrieved source content most influenced the generated answer; noted to be slow for long prompts.

nodes.label: RORA Sentence Importance Analysis
nodes.rationale: Offered as a configurable alternative to MC-Shapley for sentence-level importance/interpretability, selectable via sentence_importance_method.

nodes.label: Hybrid Reliability-Weighted Reranker
nodes.rationale: Combines dense and sparse retrieval scores with each source's on-chain reliability score so more trustworthy sources are preferred in the final ranked context.

nodes.label: Off-chain ECDSA signature compatibility (personal_sign / toEthSignedMessageHash)
nodes.rationale: Uses eth_account.messages.encode_defunct(text=...) (personal_sign semantics) specifically because it matches the DragScores contract's toEthSignedMessageHash(bytes(message)) + ECDSA.recover verification logic.

nodes.label: exact_match leaked role-token bugfix (session write-up)
nodes.rationale: open_model.py stripped Llama-3 chat-template headers and the word 'assistant' but left a leaked 'system'/'user' role token (e.g. "system\nyes"), silently deflating exact_match and every other text-overlap metric; fixed with _strip_leaked_role_tokens().

nodes.label: KB extraction rate-limit confound bugfix (session write-up)
nodes.rationale: A prior DDoS flood exhausted the shared 60-req/min Flask-Limiter budget, causing HTTP 429s to be silently coerced into 'attack found nothing'; fixed by tracking rate_limited_count separately and retrying once via Retry-After, mirroring the SFA module's existing fix.
nodes.norm_label: kb extraction rate-limit confound bugfix (session write-up)

nodes.label: 82.5% block-rate small-corpus caveat
nodes.rationale: The 82.5% block rate was measured against a 10-topic corpus with a threshold set at half that count, so a topic-balanced attacker was always going to trip it almost immediately; demonstrates the throttle mechanism works, not a production-representative block rate.

nodes.label: sfa container localhost networking bug (AUC degenerate at 0.50)
nodes.rationale: The sfa Docker container's own network namespace resolves localhost:9000 to its own loopback rather than the host LLM service, so every probe silently fails, similarity is forced to 0.0 for all documents, and AUC-ROC=0.50 is a degenerate all-positive classifier result, not a real privacy finding.
nodes.norm_label: sfa container localhost networking bug (auc degenerate at 0.50)

nodes.label: Membership Inference Attack (MIA) against PubMedQA corpus
nodes.norm_label: membership inference attack (mia) against pubmedqa corpus

nodes.label: decision_match signal (yes/no/maybe decision-commitment check)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the sole production signal (weight 1.0) after a genuine dev/test split grid search found it, alone, generalizes best to unseen seeds (mean AUC 0.620, 95% CI excludes chance) while similarity/certainty/length_ratio added net noise rather than signal.

nodes.label: Revision 7 — empirical weight re-tuning under train/test split
nodes.rationale: Revisions 5-6 diagnosed but never fixed the composite's unresolved held-out generalization; Revision 7 did a genuine dev/test seed split, grid-searched weights on 13 dev seeds, and locked weights before a single, honest evaluation on 5 fresh seeds -- avoiding the overfitting risk of re-using already-inspected seeds.
nodes.norm_label: revision 7 — empirical weight re-tuning under train/test split

nodes.label: Multi-probe consistency score signal
nodes.rationale: Motivated by the idea that a member document (real backing passage) should produce more consistent repeated answers than a non-member guessed from parametric knowledge; the most promising but least-replicated lead (AUC 0.75/0.49/0.57 across 3 seeds), not yet folded into the production composite.

nodes.label: obfuscate_decision_content() content-level defense
nodes.rationale: Built because the earlier positional obfuscate_decision() only relocates the decision token past a fixed scan window rather than removing its content, which an adaptive full-response-scanning attacker defeats; this defense detects and rewrites the token itself, closing that gap and driving adaptive/semantic attacker AUC to exactly chance.

nodes.label: Barabasi-Albert scale-free overlay simulation
nodes.rationale: Used because real P2P overlays exhibit scale-free, hub-dominated degree distributions rather than uniform-random structure, so a mock network built this way inherits realistic hub-concentrated routing traffic that motivates degree-based (high_connectivity) targeting.

nodes.label: EMA-based peer reputation tracking
nodes.rationale: An exponential moving average weights recent behavior more heavily than a simple running mean, so it adapts faster to a peer's behavior changing (e.g. an attacker starting to drop only after establishing trust).

nodes.label: Bounded redundant-probe fallback (Phase 2)
nodes.rationale: A TTL-bounded BFS that merely skips a known-blacklisted peer cannot manufacture a hop already spent discovering it; this bounded, capped fallback gives the router a small separate exploration budget so correct detection actually translates into a recovered answer under a tight hop budget, while remaining bounded (unlike the older sibling module's unbounded Phase-2 probe) to preserve research validity.

nodes.label: Live sweep rate-limit confounder diagnosis and fix (SS12.9)
nodes.rationale: Live sweeps were silently rate-limited (HTTP 429 coerced into generic misses); root cause reproduced directly, client throttle+retry added, and error tracking broadened beyond 429s to a general error_total.
nodes.norm_label: live sweep rate-limit confounder diagnosis and fix (ss12.9)

nodes.label: Unified Project Security Analysis Report (SSM-Score, MIA, SFA)
nodes.norm_label: unified project security analysis report (ssm-score, mia, sfa)

nodes.label: Bernoulli-trial drop-probability model
nodes.rationale: Real congestion doesn't fail every request uniformly -- an overloaded server serves some fraction and silently fails the rest; a single per-peer probability is the simplest model reproducing this partial-availability behavior without simulating actual queueing, capped at 0.95 so no wave creates a perfect black hole.

nodes.label: Graph-based cascade propagation to neighbours
nodes.rationale: Models the real phenomenon that an overloaded node causes queueing/retry pressure on peers that route through or to it, not just on itself; cascade intensity is capped below the direct-target formula to guarantee cascaded victims are always less damaged than direct targets.

nodes.label: Leaked chat-template role-token parsing bug (exact_match=0 confound)
nodes.rationale: open_model.py's post-processing stripped Llama-3 header markers and the word 'assistant' but left an occasional leaked 'system'/'user' role token untouched, deflating exact_match and every other text-overlap metric across every row including baseline; fixed via _strip_leaked_role_tokens().
nodes.norm_label: leaked chat-template role-token parsing bug (exact_match=0 confound)

nodes.label: QueryDiversityThrottle defense
nodes.rationale: A numeric-score-noise defense is architecturally inapplicable because /query returns raw document text with no score to perturb; the throttle instead observes topic diversity in a client's recent query window (a real, already-available signal) since a legitimate user's topic distribution should be far narrower than a systematic extractor's.

nodes.label: Corpus-drift configuration bug (sources_0.jsonl SQuAD to PubMedQA)
nodes.rationale: The attack script assumed sources_0.jsonl still held SQuAD content, an assumption invalidated when it was migrated to PubMedQA for the unrelated MIA fix; this silently made the entire attack 100% non-functional (crashed before sending a probe), which would have looked like 'the system is safe' to anyone reading only the crash, not the true untested state -- fixed by building ground truth per-source from each source's own real content.
nodes.norm_label: corpus-drift configuration bug (sources_0.jsonl squad to pubmedqa)

nodes.label: Topic-balance / stratified probe sampling strategy
nodes.rationale: A naive attacker repeating similar questions retrieves the same handful of documents; deliberately spreading probe selection across topics (stratified sampling) maximizes new coverage per query, since the retrieval oracle returns at most k=5 documents per call so coverage is bounded by how many distinct embedding-space regions are touched.
